heading: Programs authorized

tree.heading: Grants
tree.text: The Secretary may make grants to States to pay the Federal share of the cost of the programs described in section 3994 of this title.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated for purposes of carrying out this part 1 $20,000,000 for fiscal year 1988.

notes.text: References in TextThis part, referred to in subsec. (b), was in the original “this chapter” and was translated as reading “this part” to reflect the probable intent of Congress because title III of Pub. L. 98–377, which comprises this subchapter, does not contain chapters.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 98–377, title III, § 322, as added Pub. L. 100–418, title VI, § 6031(a)(2), Aug. 23, 1988, 102 Stat. 1480.)
